items.name: Symbol
items.summary: The result of looking up a symbol in a [`SemanticModel`].

methods.name: binding_id
methods.summary: Returns the [`BindingId`] if this symbol resolves to a concrete binding.

methods.name: is_bound
methods.summary: Returns `true` if this symbol resolves to any binding, including a builtin.

items.name: Modules
items.summary: A select list of Python modules that the semantic model can explicitly track.

methods.name: all
methods.summary: Get a flags value with all known bits set.

methods.name: bitand
methods.summary: The bitwise and (`&`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bitand_assign
methods.summary: The bitwise and (`&`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bitor
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bitor_assign
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bits
methods.summary: Get the underlying bits value.

methods.name: bitxor
methods.summary: The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: bitxor_assign
methods.summary: The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: complement
methods.summary: The bitwise negation (`!`) of the bits in `self`, truncating the result.

methods.name: contains

methods.summary: Whether all set bits in `other` are also set in `self`.

methods.name: difference

methods.name: empty

methods.name: extend

methods.name: from_bits_retain
methods.summary: Convert from a bits value exactly.

methods.name: from_bits_truncate

methods.name: from_iter
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in each flags value.

methods.name: from_name
methods.summary: Get a flags value with the bits of a flag with the given name set.

methods.name: insert
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: intersection

methods.summary: The bitwise and (`&`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: intersects

methods.name: is_all
methods.summary: Whether all known bits in this flags value are set.

methods.name: is_empty

methods.name: iter

methods.name: iter_names
methods.summary: Yield a set of contained named flags values.

methods.name: not

methods.name: remove
methods.summary: The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).

methods.name: set

methods.summary: Call `insert` when `value` is `true` or `remove` when `value` is `false`.

methods.name: sub
methods.summary: The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).

methods.name: sub_assign
methods.summary: The intersection of `self` with the complement of `other` (`&!`).

methods.summary: The bitwise exclusive-or (`^`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

methods.name: toggle

methods.name: union
methods.signature: const fn union(self, other: Self) -> Self
methods.summary: The bitwise or (`|`) of the bits in `self` and `other`.

items.name: SemanticModel
items.summary: A semantic model for a Python module, to enable querying the module's semantic information.

methods.name: add_delayed_annotation
methods.signature: fn add_delayed_annotation(&mut self, binding_id: BindingId, annotation_id: BindingId)
methods.summary: Add a [`BindingId`] to the list of delayed annotations for the given [`BindingId`].

methods.name: add_global_reference
methods.signature: fn add_global_reference(&mut self, binding_id: BindingId, ctx: ExprContext, range: TextRange)
methods.summary: Add a reference to the given [`BindingId`] in the global scope.

methods.name: add_local_reference
methods.signature: fn add_local_reference(&mut self, binding_id: BindingId, ctx: ExprContext, range: TextRange)
methods.summary: Add a reference to the given [`BindingId`] in the local scope.

methods.name: add_module
methods.summary: Mark a Python module as "seen" by the semantic model. Future callers can quickly discount the need to resolve symbols from these modules if they haven't been seen.

methods.name: add_rebinding_scope
methods.signature: fn add_rebinding_scope(&mut self, binding_id: BindingId, scope_id: ScopeId)
methods.summary: Mark the given [`BindingId`] as rebound in the given [`ScopeId`] (i.e., declared as `global` or `nonlocal`).

methods.name: at_top_level
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is at the top level of the module (i.e., in the module scope, and not nested within any statements).

methods.name: binding
methods.summary: Return the [`Binding`] for the given [`BindingId`].

methods.name: current_expression
methods.summary: Return the current [`Expr`].

methods.name: current_expression_grandparent
methods.summary: Return the grandparent [`Expr`] of the current [`Expr`], if any.

methods.name: current_expression_parent
methods.summary: Return the parent [`Expr`] of the current [`Expr`], if any.

methods.name: current_expressions
methods.summary: Returns an [`Iterator`] over the current expression hierarchy, from the current [`Expr`] through to any parents.

methods.name: current_scope
methods.summary: Returns the current top-most [`Scope`].

methods.name: current_scope_ids
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over all scopes IDs, starting from the current [`Scope`].

methods.name: current_scope_mut
methods.summary: Returns a mutable reference to the current top-most [`Scope`].

methods.name: current_scopes
methods.summary: Returns an iterator over all scopes, starting from the current [`Scope`].

methods.name: current_statement
methods.summary: Return the current [`Stmt`].

methods.name: current_statement_id
methods.summary: Return the [`NodeId`] of the current [`Stmt`], if any.

methods.name: current_statement_ids
methods.summary: Returns an [`Iterator`] over the current statement hierarchy represented as [`NodeId`], from the current [`NodeId`] through to any parents.

methods.name: current_statement_parent
methods.summary: Return the parent [`Stmt`] of the current [`Stmt`], if any.

methods.name: current_statement_parent_id
methods.summary: Return the [`NodeId`] of the current [`Stmt`] parent, if any.

methods.name: current_statements
methods.summary: Returns an [`Iterator`] over the current statement hierarchy, from the current [`Stmt`] through to any parents.

methods.name: delayed_annotations
methods.summary: Return the list of delayed annotations for the given [`BindingId`].

methods.name: dominates
methods.signature: fn dominates(&self, dominator: NodeId, node: NodeId) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns `true` if any execution path to `node` passes through `dominator`.

methods.name: execution_context
methods.summary: Return the [`ExecutionContext`] of the current scope.

methods.name: expression
methods.signature: fn expression(&self, node_id: NodeId) -> Option<&'a Expr>
methods.summary: Return the [`Expr`] corresponding to the given [`NodeId`].

methods.name: expressions
methods.signature: fn expressions(&self, node_id: NodeId) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a Expr> + '_
methods.summary: Returns an [`Iterator`] over the expressions, starting from the given [`NodeId`]. through to any parents.

methods.name: extract_dunder_all_names
methods.summary: Extract the names bound to a given __all__ assignment.

methods.name: first_non_type_parent_scope
methods.summary: Returns the first parent of the given [`Scope`] that is not of [`ScopeKind::Type`] or [`ScopeKind::DunderClassCell`], if any.

methods.name: first_non_type_parent_scope_id
methods.summary: Returns the first parent of the given [`ScopeId`] that is not of [`ScopeKind::Type`] or [`ScopeKind::DunderClassCell`], if any.

methods.name: function_scope
methods.summary: Finds and returns the [`Scope`] corresponding to a given [`ast::StmtFunctionDef`].

methods.name: future_annotations_or_stub
methods.summary: Return `true` if `__future__`-style type annotations are enabled.

methods.name: global
methods.summary: Return the [`TextRange`] at which a name is declared as global in the current [`Scope`].

methods.name: global_binding
methods.signature: fn global_binding(&mut self, symbol: &'a str) -> Option<BindingId>
methods.summary: Return a binding from the global scope, materializing it first if it is a builtin.

methods.name: global_scope
methods.summary: Returns a reference to the global [`Scope`].

methods.name: has_builtin_binding
methods.summary: Return `true` if `member` is bound as a builtin *in the scope we are currently visiting*.

methods.name: has_builtin_binding_in_scope
methods.signature: fn has_builtin_binding_in_scope(&self, member: &str, scope: ScopeId) -> bool
methods.summary: Return `true` if `member` is bound as a builtin *in a given scope*.

methods.name: in_annotated_type_alias_value
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting the value expression of a [PEP 613] type alias.

methods.name: in_annotation
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a type annotation.

methods.name: in_assert_statement
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in an `assert` statement.

methods.name: in_async_context
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in an async context.

methods.name: in_attribute_docstring
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in an attribute docstring.

methods.name: in_boolean_test
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in boolean test.

methods.name: in_class_base
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting an item in a class's bases tuple (e.g. `Foo` in `class Bar(Foo): ...`)

methods.name: in_complex_string_type_definition
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting a "complex string type definition" that was previously deferred when initially traversing the AST

methods.name: in_deferred_class_base
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting an item in a class's bases tuple that was initially deferred while traversing the AST. (This only happens in stub files.)

methods.name: in_deferred_type_alias_value
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting the value expression of a [PEP 695] type alias.

methods.name: in_deferred_type_definition
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting any kind of type definition that was previously deferred when initially traversing the AST

methods.name: in_dunder_all_definition
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting the r.h.s. of an `__all__` definition (e.g. `"foo"` in `__all__ = ["foo"]`)

methods.name: in_exception_handler
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in an exception handler.

methods.name: in_f_string
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in an f-string.

methods.name: in_interpolated_string
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in an f-string or t-string.

methods.name: in_interpolated_string_replacement_field
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in an f-string replacement field.

methods.name: in_named_expression_assignment
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a named expression assignment (e.g., `x := 1`).

methods.name: in_nested_literal
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a nested literal expression (e.g., the inner `Literal` in `Literal[Literal[int, str], float]`).

methods.name: in_nested_union
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a nested union expression (e.g., the inner `Union` in `Union[Union[int, str], float]`).

methods.name: in_no_type_check
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a `@no_type_check` context.

methods.name: in_orelse
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in an exception handler.

methods.name: in_pep_257_docstring
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a docstring as described in [PEP 257].

methods.name: in_protocol_or_abstract_method
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a `typing.Protocol` subclass or an abstract method.

methods.name: in_runtime_evaluated_annotation
methods.summary: Return `true` if the context is in a runtime-evaluated type annotation.

methods.name: in_runtime_required_annotation
methods.summary: Return `true` if the context is in a runtime-required type annotation.

methods.name: in_simple_string_type_definition
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting a "simple string type definition" that was previously deferred when initially traversing the AST

methods.name: in_string_type_definition
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting a "string type definition" that was previously deferred when initially traversing the AST

methods.name: in_stub_file
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a stub file (i.e., a file with a `.pyi` extension).

methods.name: in_subscript
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a subscript expression.

methods.name: in_type_alias_value
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is visiting the value expression of either kind of type alias.

methods.name: in_type_checking_block
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a type-checking block.

methods.name: in_type_definition
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a type definition.

methods.name: in_typing_literal
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a `typing::Literal` annotation.

methods.name: in_typing_only_annotation
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is in a typing-only type annotation.

methods.name: inside_optional
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model is directly inside an Optional (e.g., the inner `Union` in `Optional[Union[int, str]]`).

methods.name: is_available
methods.summary: Return `true` if `member` is an "available" symbol, i.e., a symbol that has not been bound in the current scope currently being visited, or in any containing scope.

methods.name: is_available_in_scope
methods.signature: fn is_available_in_scope(&self, member: &str, scope_id: ScopeId) -> bool
methods.summary: Return `true` if `member` is an "available" symbol in a given scope, i.e., a symbol that has not been bound in that current scope, or in any containing scope.

methods.name: is_current_scope
methods.summary: Return `true` if the given [`ScopeId`] matches that of the current scope.

methods.name: is_unused
methods.summary: Returns `true` if the given expression is an unused variable, or consists solely of references to other unused variables. This method is conservative in that it considers a variable to be "used" if it's shadowed by another variable with us…

methods.name: lookup_attribute
methods.summary: Lookup a qualified attribute in the current scope.

methods.name: lookup_attribute_in_scope
methods.signature: fn lookup_attribute_in_scope(&self, value: &Expr, scope_id: ScopeId) -> Option<BindingId>
methods.summary: Lookup a qualified attribute in the certain scope.

methods.name: lookup_binding
methods.signature: fn lookup_binding(&mut self, symbol: &'a str) -> Option<BindingId>
methods.summary: Lookup a concrete binding in the current scope.

methods.name: lookup_symbol
methods.summary: Lookup a symbol in the current scope without materializing lazy builtins.

methods.name: lookup_symbol_in_scope
methods.signature: fn lookup_symbol_in_scope(&self, symbol: &str, scope_id: ScopeId, in_forward_reference: bool) -> Symbol
methods.summary: Lookup a symbol in a certain scope without materializing lazy builtins.

methods.name: match_builtin_expr
methods.summary: Return `true` if `expr` is a reference to `builtins.$target`, i.e. either `object` (where `object` is not overridden in the global scope), or `builtins.object` (where `builtins` is imported as a module at the top level)

methods.name: match_typing_expr
methods.summary: Return `true` if the `Expr` is a reference to `typing.${target}`.

methods.name: match_typing_qualified_name
methods.summary: Return `true` if the call path is a reference to `typing.${target}`.

methods.name: new
methods.signature: fn new(typing_modules: &'a [String], custom_builtins: &'a [String], target_version: PythonVersion, source_type: PySourceType, path: &Path, module: Module<'a>) -> Self

methods.name: node
methods.summary: Return the [`Stmt`] corresponding to the given [`NodeId`].

methods.name: nonlocal
methods.summary: Given a `name` that has been declared `nonlocal`, return the [`ScopeId`] and [`BindingId`] to which it refers.

methods.name: only_binding
methods.summary: Resolves the [`ast::ExprName`] to the [`BindingId`] of the symbol it refers to, if it's the only binding to that name in its scope.

methods.name: parent_expression_id
methods.summary: Given a [`NodeId`], return the [`NodeId`] of the parent expression, if any.

methods.name: parent_statement
methods.signature: fn parent_statement(&self, node_id: NodeId) -> Option<&'a Stmt>
methods.summary: Given a [`Stmt`], return its parent, if any.

methods.name: parent_statement_id
methods.summary: Given a [`NodeId`], return the [`NodeId`] of the parent statement, if any.

methods.name: pop_branch
methods.summary: Pop the current [`BranchId`] off the stack.

methods.name: pop_definition
methods.summary: Pop the current [`Member`] off the stack.

methods.name: pop_node
methods.summary: Pop the current AST node [`NodeRef`] off the stack.

methods.name: pop_scope
methods.summary: Pop the current [`Scope`] off the stack.

methods.name: push_binding
methods.signature: fn push_binding(&mut self, name: &'a str, range: TextRange, kind: BindingKind<'a>, flags: BindingFlags) -> BindingId
methods.summary: Create a new [`Binding`] for the given `name` and `range`.

methods.name: push_branch
methods.summary: Push a new branch onto the stack, returning its [`BranchId`].

methods.name: push_definition
methods.summary: Push a [`Member`] onto the stack.

methods.name: push_node
methods.signature: fn push_node<T: Into<NodeRef<'a>>>(&mut self, node: T)
methods.summary: Push an AST node [`NodeRef`] onto the stack.

methods.name: push_scope
methods.summary: Push a [`Scope`] with the given [`ScopeKind`] onto the stack.

methods.name: rebinding_scopes
methods.summary: Return the list of [`ScopeId`]s in which the given [`BindingId`] is rebound (i.e., declared as `global` or `nonlocal`).

methods.name: reference
methods.summary: Resolve the [`ResolvedReference`] for the given [`ResolvedReferenceId`].

methods.name: resolve_builtin_symbol
methods.signature: fn resolve_builtin_symbol<'expr>(&'a self, expr: &'expr Expr) -> Option<&'a str> where 'expr: 'a
methods.summary: If `expr` is a reference to a builtins symbol, return the name of that symbol. Else, return `None`.

methods.name: resolve_del
methods.signature: fn resolve_del(&mut self, symbol: &'a str, range: TextRange)
methods.summary: Resolve a `del` reference to `symbol` at `range`.

methods.name: resolve_load
methods.signature: fn resolve_load(&mut self, name: &'a ast::ExprName) -> ReadResult
methods.summary: Resolve a `load` reference to an [`ast::ExprName`].

methods.name: resolve_name
methods.summary: Resolves the [`ast::ExprName`] to the [`BindingId`] of the symbol it refers to, if any.

methods.name: resolve_qualified_import_name
methods.summary: Given a `module` and `member`, return the fully-qualified name of the binding in the current scope, if it exists.

methods.name: resolve_qualified_name
methods.signature: fn resolve_qualified_name<'name, 'expr: 'name>(&self, value: &'expr Expr) -> Option<QualifiedName<'name>> where 'a: 'name
methods.summary: Resolves the [`Expr`] to a fully-qualified symbol-name, if `value` resolves to an imported or builtin symbol.

methods.name: restore
methods.summary: Restore the semantic model to the given [`Snapshot`].

methods.name: same_branch
methods.signature: fn same_branch(&self, left: NodeId, right: NodeId) -> bool
methods.summary: Returns `true` if `left` and `right` are in the same branches of an `if`, `match`, or `try` statement.

methods.name: seen_import_boundary
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model has traversed past the "top-of-file" import boundary.

methods.name: seen_module
methods.summary: Return `true` if the [`Module`] was "seen" anywhere in the semantic model. This is used as a fast path to avoid unnecessary work when resolving symbols.

methods.name: seen_module_docstring_boundary
methods.summary: Return `true` if the model has traversed past the module docstring boundary.

methods.name: set_branch
methods.summary: Set the current [`BranchId`].

methods.name: set_globals
methods.summary: Set the [`Globals`] for the current [`Scope`].

methods.name: shadowed_binding
methods.summary: Return the [`BindingId`] that the given [`BindingId`] shadows, if any.

methods.name: shadowed_bindings
methods.signature: fn shadowed_bindings(&self, scope_id: ScopeId, binding_id: BindingId) -> impl Iterator<Item = ShadowedBinding> + '_
methods.summary: Return an iterator over all bindings shadowed by the given [`BindingId`], within the containing scope, and across scopes.

methods.name: simulate_runtime_load
methods.signature: fn simulate_runtime_load(&self, name: &ast::ExprName, typing_only_bindings_status: TypingOnlyBindingsStatus) -> Option<BindingId>
methods.summary: Simulates a runtime load of a given [`ast::ExprName`].

methods.name: simulate_runtime_load_at_location_in_scope
methods.signature: fn simulate_runtime_load_at_location_in_scope(&self, symbol: &str, symbol_range: TextRange, scope_id: ScopeId, typing_only_bindings_status: TypingOnlyBindingsStatus) -> Option<BindingId>
methods.summary: Simulates a runtime load of the given symbol.

methods.name: snapshot
methods.summary: Generate a [`Snapshot`] of the current semantic model.

methods.name: statement
methods.summary: Return the [`Stmt`] corresponding to the given [`NodeId`].

methods.name: statements
methods.signature: fn statements(&self, node_id: NodeId) -> impl Iterator<Item = &'a Stmt> + '_
methods.summary: Returns an [`Iterator`] over the statements, starting from the given [`NodeId`]. through to any parents.

methods.name: typing_modules
methods.summary: Return an iterator over the set of `typing` modules allowed in the semantic model.

methods.name: unresolved_references
methods.summary: Return an iterator over all [`UnresolvedReference`]s in the semantic model.
